name: brain
description: A lightweight knowledge graph: people/companies/topics become entities, mail and notes become observations. Enriched by contacts.lookup when the contacts package is present.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 014_brain.sql, hot-loads the app).
Entities grow automatically from incoming mail (with the email package); add entities and observations manually too.
Uses the contacts.lookup capability — the gateway verifies it is provided at load time (see /api/capabilities).
